preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 4.
The integer k must be between 1 and 15 for each test case.
Each row must contain exactly 2k + 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) or x == 'E' for x in first_row + second_row)
preconditions.description: Each element in the rows must be an integer or the letter 'E'.
There must be exactly one 'E' in the combined rows of each test case.

postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether the surgery is complete or failed.
If the surgery is complete, the total length of all strings in the output must be at most 10^4.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SURGERY COMPLETE' and all(move in 'udlr' for move in moves)
postconditions.description: If the surgery is complete, the moves must consist only of the characters 'u', 'd', 'l', and 'r'.
